# Warudo script functions

Functions for C# (`Cb.Call`) and Python (a `cb` method each, or `cb.call`). See [Script functions](index.md) for how to use them.

![A Run Python code step in the action editor](../../assets/screens/actions-python-step.png)

## warudo.getToggle

Asks Warudo whether an "On Stream Deck Toggle" node is on.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `receiver` | `receiver` | The Receiver Name typed into the node. |

**Gives back:** true when on, false when off, null when Warudo does not know this toggle.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("warudo.getToggle", new { receiver = "Hat" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.warudo_get_toggle(receiver="Hat")
    ```

## warudo.isConnected

Checks whether Cuebot is connected to Warudo's Stream Deck service.

**Gives back:** true while connected, otherwise false.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("warudo.isConnected");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.warudo_is_connected()
    ```

## warudo.sendMessage

Sends text to every "On Stream Deck Message" node with this Receiver Name.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `receiver` | `receiver` | The Receiver Name typed into the node. |
| `message` | `message` | The text the node passes on. |

**Gives back:** Nothing.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("warudo.sendMessage", new { receiver = "Say", message = "Thanks for the follow!" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.warudo_send_message(receiver="Say", message="Thanks for the follow!")
    ```

## warudo.sendWebSocket

Sends text to Warudo's own WebSocket port (19190), which starts every "On WebSocket Message Received" node. Needs no Stream Deck node.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | `message` | The text to send, for example a viewer's name or some JSON. |

**Gives back:** Nothing.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("warudo.sendWebSocket", new { message = "Zed" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.warudo_send_web_socket(message="Zed")
    ```

## warudo.setToggle

Turns "On Stream Deck Toggle" nodes with this Receiver Name on (their If Yes path) or off (their If No path). For On and Off, Cuebot skips the flip when the toggle is already right.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `receiver` | `receiver` | The Receiver Name typed into the node. |
| `state` | `state` | Optional. On, Off or Toggle. The default is Toggle. |

**Gives back:** true when Warudo reports it is now on, false when off, null when Warudo did not report a state.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("warudo.setToggle", new { receiver = "Hat", state = "On" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.warudo_set_toggle(receiver="Hat", state="On")
    ```

## warudo.trigger

Starts every "On Stream Deck Trigger" node in Warudo with this Receiver Name.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `receiver` | `receiver` | The Receiver Name typed into the node. Capital letters matter. |

**Gives back:** Nothing.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("warudo.trigger", new { receiver = "Confetti" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.warudo_trigger(receiver="Confetti")
    ```
